description: RemotePatch round-trip (load half, ADR-0028 phase 6). Loads test_output/remote_patch_persistence/test.entity saved by remote_patch_persistence_save.json and verifies both patches survived the reload. RenameRemotePatch succeeds only when a RemotePatch component exists on the target layer (and the slot was rebound at load), so the two renames are positive existence assertions: if either patch failed to persist or rebind, the rename fails and the script exits nonzero.
